statusText: WATCH / yellow: Sunday reopening risk is active; available evidence does not yet show persistent NQ mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The first reopening hours are the active price-structure checkpoint; a higher Tail state requires observed persistent extension or failed retracements.
headline: Reopening begins under extreme headline stress without confirmed one-way NQ structure
body: Sunday Globex has reopened. A secondary market report describes U.S. equity futures as opening slightly lower, but sufficiently current granular NQ evidence is not available to verify shallow pullbacks, failed retracements or session-extreme holding. Iran/Houthi escalation, high rates and unresolved U.S.-China talks keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Prior 24 UTC hours: Tail 15-19%, Stress 91-97%, and every published slot was green / EA_ON with dominant mode normal.
outlookSummary: Current WATCH is concentrated in the Sunday reopening window because headline and gap uncertainty are extreme while granular NQ path evidence remains limited. Tail is expected to normalize if meaningful retracements develop, with a second conditional WATCH window around Monday's U.S. cash open.

forecast.analysis: Sunday Globex has reopened. A secondary market report describes U.S. equity futures as opening slightly lower, but no sufficiently current granular NQ source yet establishes persistent extension, failed retracements, or session-extreme holding. Tail stays in WATCH rather than escalating.
drivers: Granular NQ retracement evidence remains unavailable

forecast.analysis: In the second reopening hour, WATCH remains conditional on whether the first impulse extends after shallow or failed pullbacks. A meaningful retracement or reversal would weaken the Tail case even if headline volatility remains elevated.

news.title: Iran and US trade threats after Houthi attacks escalate regional conflict
US Treasury's Bessent and China's He launch talks on AI, trade and critical minerals

forecast.analysis: By 00:00 UTC, WATCH is conditional on persistence from the Sunday open. Repeated extension with little retracement would support higher Tail; two-way discovery and fading gap pressure would argue for normalization.
drivers: Two-way trade is the normalization checkpoint

news.title: Saudi, Gulf stocks fall after Houthis claim Riyadh attacks

forecast.analysis: At 01:00 UTC, the base case moves below WATCH if the reopening has developed meaningful retracements and two-way trade. A one-way extension without such retracements would invalidate that normalization.
drivers: No-retracement extension is the key invalidation

forecast.analysis: Thin overnight trading keeps Stress high, but Tail remains low if price rotates rather than repeatedly extending. Weekend geopolitical headlines remain capable of abrupt repricing without implying persistent mean-reversion failure.

news.title: Iran and US trade threats after Houthi attacks escalate regional conflict

forecast.analysis: During the late U.S. evening, low Tail assumes the reopening impulse has not become directionally efficient. Persistent movement near an overnight extreme with failed pullbacks would be the main reason to reassess.
drivers: Failed pullbacks would challenge the base case

forecast.analysis: As Asia becomes the main liquidity center, Tail remains low if regional risk assets and NQ do not align into a persistent one-way move. Cross-asset disagreement would keep Stress elevated while limiting directional conviction.

The Asia-to-Europe handoff is expected to remain two-way unless fresh geopolitical or trade headlines create a new directional impulse. Tail stays low without repeated extension or shallow retracement structure.
drivers: Repeated extension remains absent in the base case

forecast.analysis: Ahead of the European cash open, Tail rises only modestly because a fresh regional impulse can widen overnight ranges. The key conditional test is whether NQ follows that impulse with shallow retracements rather than rotating.
drivers: NQ retracement behavior is the conditional test

forecast.analysis: Around the European cash open, Tail approaches the top of the low band. A synchronized move in European equities, oil and rates could increase directional pressure, but persistence still requires NQ extension with failed pullbacks.

news.title: Saudi, Gulf stocks fall after Houthis claim Riyadh attacks

forecast.analysis: After the European open, the base case favors lower Tail if the first regional impulse retraces. Continued one-way movement across equities, oil and rates would keep Stress high and could delay normalization.
drivers: One-way regional continuation is the invalidation

forecast.analysis: European mid-morning is a lower-risk window if overnight ranges have stabilized. Tail remains low unless fresh headlines or renewed rate pressure produce a directional NQ extension that resists retracement.
Into the European midday lull, Tail stays low in the absence of directional efficiency. Stress remains high because geopolitical and inflation uncertainty persist even if price action is rotational.

Before the U.S. premarket becomes dominant, low Tail assumes no renewed overnight extreme-holding. Fresh U.S. policy or geopolitical headlines could raise Stress quickly, but Tail requires sustained NQ structure.

During the U.S. premarket build, Tail edges higher as liquidity and headline sensitivity increase. A large directional premarket move would still need shallow or failed retracements before it supports a stronger Tail assessment.

news.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is still too high in 'all aspects' of US economy

forecast.analysis: The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open falls inside this hour. WATCH is conditional on the opening auction: persistent continuation, shallow pullbacks and cross-asset alignment would sustain Tail, while an early retracement would cap it.

news.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is still too high in 'all aspects' of US economy
Iran and US trade threats after Houthi attacks escalate regional conflict

forecast.analysis: In the first full post-open hour, WATCH depends on whether the initial cash-session impulse extends after failed retracements. A meaningful counter-move or broader two-way breadth would reduce Tail despite still-high Stress.

By 15:00 UTC, WATCH is conditional on unresolved opening momentum. If price has already retraced and breadth is mixed, Tail should fall below the watch band; repeated extension would keep it elevated.

Late U.S. morning favors lower Tail if the session has developed normal pullbacks and rotation. Stress can remain high because rates, oil and geopolitics may still produce abrupt but recoverable moves.
drivers: Rates and oil remain stress amplifiers

forecast.analysis: The U.S. midday period is expected to carry lower Tail if directional efficiency has faded. A fresh geopolitical or trade headline would first raise Stress unless the resulting NQ move persists without meaningful retracement.
Early U.S. afternoon remains a low-Tail base case if price continues to mean-revert within the day’s range. A renewed move toward session extremes would become more important only if pullbacks fail.
drivers: Failed pullbacks would matter more than move size

forecast.analysis: Approaching power hour, Tail edges higher because late-session positioning can amplify an existing trend. The move remains conditional: extension near session extremes with shallow pullbacks would matter; ordinary rotation would not.
During power hour, Tail sits at the top of the low band. A persistent closing drive with failed retracements would justify reassessment; a two-way close would leave Stress high but Tail contained.

The U.S. cash close is complete and the CME daily maintenance halt begins at 21:00 UTC. With no live NQ path during the halt, Tail falls back to low while residual geopolitical and policy uncertainty keeps Stress elevated.

forecastDetail.comment: Reopening is active; a slightly lower initial tone is visible, but granular NQ evidence does not yet confirm persistent extension or failed retracements.
WATCH remains conditional on whether the first reopening impulse extends after shallow or failed pullbacks; meaningful retracement would weaken Tail.
Persistence from the Sunday open is the key test; two-way discovery would support normalization, while repeated extension would keep WATCH.
Below-WATCH normalization assumes meaningful retracements and two-way trade; a one-way extension would invalidate the base case.
Thin overnight liquidity keeps Stress high, but Tail remains low if price rotates instead of repeatedly extending.
Late-evening Tail stays low unless NQ holds near an overnight extreme and pullbacks repeatedly fail.
